text: 插件管家（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 的插件列表补上中文或英文名称、用途说明和分类，并提供集中管理界面。它由主机端读取当前插件加载器与目录数据，再通过远程服务把条目交给浏览器端，在“设置→插件”注册标签页。用户可以搜索和筛选插件、一键启停、编辑名称与说明、恢复内置备注，也可导出和预览导入配置备份。系统插件和表达式控制的行会标记为不可切换；自定义备注保存在本机 DSH 配置目录。适合已安装多个插件、需要辨认用途并维护开关和备注的 DSH Web 用户。无需 API Key；可选配置本地或 HTTPS 社区目录源。

Plugin Manager (DSH Web) adds bilingual descriptions to loaded plugins. Its Settings tab supports search, filters, eligible toggles, note editing, and backup export or preview. System rows cannot be toggled. Notes stay local. No API key is required; optional catalogs may be local or HTTPS.

插件管家的功能「插件说明目录」：按插件加载器条目展示双语名称、描述和分类，并提供模块名等检索和类别筛选。用户打开“设置→插件”标签页后查看和过滤当前列表。
插件管家的功能「插件启停」：在插件条目上切换启用状态，主机端编辑全局 cordis.patch.yml 的对应行；系统行和由 !!js 表达式控制的行会被拒绝切换。
插件管家的功能「自定义插件备注」：用户在条目编辑名称或说明并保存，内容写入 DSH 本地 catalog.json；也可以删除覆盖并恢复目录中的默认值。
插件管家的功能「配置备份与恢复」：用户可导出当前配置 JSON，选择备份后先查看恢复预览，再确认导入；恢复内容涵盖备注覆盖、profile 依赖与 bundles，以及启停补丁。

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Overview：**Problem.** The built-in "Plugin list" in DeepSeek Harness shows only English module names with no descriptions — once you install many plugins, nobody can tell what each row does. Enable/disable previously required hand-editing `cordis.patch.yml`, which is easy to break.

**Who it's for.** Every DeepSeek Harness user, especially people who install many plugins and want to know what each one does, toggle them safely, and annotate the ones the catalog doesn't cover.

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Overview：| Pain | Before | With this plugin |
|------|--------|------------------|
| Plugin list is meaningless | English module names only, no clue what each row does | Chinese name + one-line description + category for every plugin |
| Toggling is manual | Hand-edit `cordis.patch.yml` (easy to break) | One-click switch, surgical line-level edits, hot-reloaded in ~1s |
| Unknown plugins stay mysterious | Fallback text only | Add your own notes directly in the UI |
| Nothing is safe from fat fingers | Any row can be disabled | System rows locked, `!!js`-controlled rows labeled |

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Configuration：| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| Toggle file | `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (global layer, hot-reloaded by DSH) |
| Notes override file | `~/.dsh/plugin-manager/catalog.json` (auto-created on first save) |
| Community catalog sources | Optional `~/.dsh/plugin-manager/catalog-sources.json`; HTTPS or local JSON only, manually maintained in this release |
| Environment variables | None of its own; follows DSH's `DSH_HOME` resolution for the files above |
| Defaults | User override → later community sources override earlier ones → built-in catalog → English short name → fallback text |
| Sensitive items | None — no keys, tokens, or credentials are read or stored |

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Permissions & Data：| Scope | What it touches |
|-------|-----------------|
| Files (read) | `cordis.patch.yml`, `plugin-manager/catalog.json`, optional `plugin-manager/catalog-sources.json` plus local source JSON files it names, the in-process loader plugin list, and the profile `package.json` (backup) |
| Files (write) | `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (toggle rows), `~/.dsh/plugin-manager/catalog.json` (notes), and the profile `package.json` (restore) — inside the DSH home only |
| Network | The browser half talks only to your local DSH `/api` RPC endpoint. If you configure an HTTPS catalog source, the host half fetches that JSON once per launch |
| Credentials | Never read |
| User data | Never read (no access to sessions, messages, or prompts) |

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Permissions & Data：**Access control.** This plugin uses DSH's Host access policy. On DSH 0.2.1+, the Gateway permits only owner Peers to call this plugin's Remote endpoints, including `list`, and rejects non-owner or disposed Peers before calling the service. Older hosts retain their own trust boundary. The tab footer displays local configuration paths returned by `list`.

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 📚 Bilingual catalog | 190+ built-in entries (name / description / category) in Chinese and English — the English UI shows English names/descriptions, falling back to the module short name + an English note instead of Chinese. Unlisted modules fall back automatically; every entry is customizable |
| 🌐 Community sources | Optional local/HTTPS JSON catalog sources; invalid sources produce a warning and are skipped, while the built-in catalog and notes keep working |
| 🔘 One-click toggle | Writes `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (global layer); DSH's HMR watcher re-applies within ~1 second; enabling writes an explicit `disabled: false` that overrides lower layers |

| 🛡️ Safety guards | Bootstrap/transport/settings-shell rows locked as "System"; `!!js`-expression rows labeled "Expression-controlled"; a warning banner appears if the official plugin manager is still loaded alongside (takeover did not happen); a broken override file is rep

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · How It Works：| Half | File | Role |
|------|------|------|
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers the `dshPluginManager` cordis service (Typert remote): `list` / `setEnabled` / `setOverride` / `removeOverride` / `exportBackup` / `previewBackup` / `importBackup` / `quarantineOverrides`. Toggles use surgical patch-file editing — comments and `!!js` expressions preserved. Every file-writing method shares one serialized write queue (no cross-operation lost updates), and import runs as a read-only preview followed by a confirmed merge. |
| Host | `lib/typert.host.js` | Exports `./typert`; the typert-loader registers it as **strict invocation definitions**. Crucial fix: under tsx source launch the gateway and an external plugin can hold two copies of typert-protocol — decorator markers are invisible across copies (symptom: every call 404s). Strict registration goes through the shared registry, sidestepping module-instance identity. |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Mounts the `dshPluginManager` remote namespace via the inject-free `ctx.get()` channel (avoids a self-mount deadlock) and registers the Plugin Manager tab in the `settings.plugins.tab` slo

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · How It Works：> Runtime dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol` resolve through DSH's `profiles/node_modules` fallback links — no extra pnpm downloads.

is display metadata only: it does not install code, enable plugins, or make
anything executable. Later sources win field by field; user notes still win
over every source.

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Community Catalog Sources：`category` must be one of the built-in functional categories (`core`, `llm`,
`session`, `agent`, `tool`, `skill`, `ui`, `web`, `sandbox`, `storage`,
`other`); invalid values fall back to `other`. The existing PerryLink
top-level array is accepted as a legacy format: `displayName` is the English
name, `locale: "zh"` maps `summary` to the Chinese description, `summaryZh`
supplies Chinese text for English summaries, and the first legacy category is
mapped to the nearest built-in functional category.

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Community Catalog Sources：Broken or too-large source files are skipped with a warning banner; local paths
are resolved relative to `catalog-sources.json`. HTTPS is the only allowed
remote protocol in v1, sources are cached once per DSH launch, and editing the
source list requires restarting DSH.

@txc2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| The tab doesn't appear | Restart DeepSeek Harness, then Ctrl+F5 the page (client bundles load at boot) |
| "暂时无法读取插件" with an error block | Read the gray error detail under the message: `dshPluginManager.list failed: ...` / `transport failure ...` and match it below |
| Error mentions **404** or `invocation-unavailable` | Your installed version is older than 0.2.0 (missing `./typert` strict registration) — update and restart |
| `cannot get property "remote.dshPluginManager" without inject` | Version older than 0.2.2 — update and refresh |
| A toggle doesn't seem to work | Check `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` keeps row-block structure (a `- ` dash at column 0); rows labeled "表达式控制" are `!!js`-controlled — edit the config file directly |
| pnpm warns `peer range @deepseek-ai/*@* does not match resolved 0.2.0-rc.2` | Harmless — DSH ships these as prereleases and semver `*` doesn't match them. v0.7.0+ declares `>=0.1.0-rc.0 \|\| >=0.1.5-rc.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-rc.0`; for other plugins add `peerDependencyRules.allowAny: ['@deepseek-ai/*']` to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` |
